title: English netsh is the only source for the NIC profile -> degraded, never pass
titleZh: 英文 netsh 是网卡 profile 的唯一来源 -> 降级,绝不报 pass
why: When the admin-only Get-NetConnectionProfile is unavailable the collector has to parse a localized netsh header. That path must be labelled as low confidence and reported as degraded - presenting a text parse as proven would be a lie (defensive-spec 4.1).
inject: -NoNative with the cmdlet probe removed from the fixture, so only the netsh text can answer
